auto_apply_thresholds.ceiling_rule: R-6: the decision's ORIGINAL proposed_action severity must itself be at or below light_friction — not merely the model's clamped recommendation, which derive_effect already bounds there

fake_reviewer_rule_table.citation_mechanism: cites evidence_keys[0] verbatim; raises ValueError rather than fabricating a fallback citation when the allowlist is empty
fake_reviewer_rule_table.seed_mechanism: int(sha256(structured_evidence_segment_text)[:16], 16) — stable across processes and PYTHONHASHSEED, keyed on case identity because the structured payload embeds decision_id. The untrusted appeal block is located only to be skipped and never reaches the rule table.

gating_rule.citation_rule: C-2: citations are kept only if they resolve against the case's evidence_keys allowlist; unresolved citations move to unverified_claims and a verdict with zero valid citations can never reverse
gating_rule.cluster_blast_radius_rule: L-3/RC-1 P1-1: auto-apply is blocked whenever another currently-actioned decision shares this decision's cluster_snapshot_id AND its exact policy_engine.evidence_signature; both signatures are derived from the raw persisted decision_evidence payload, never from the ReviewCase projection
gating_rule.combination_rule: strict unanimity (C-5): all samples must derive the same effect; any disagreement escalates, regardless of majority
gating_rule.escalate_rule: L-5: an escalate outcome is a real state transition (under_review + an EscalationRecord with a 7-day window), not a label on the LlmReview rows
gating_rule.repair_retry_rule: R-7: exactly one repair retry per sample before failing closed to escalate; every attempt is persisted as its own LlmReview row
gating_rule.severity_clamp_rule: C-4: the model's recommended_action is clamped to min(model, policy_proposed_action) over policy_engine.ACTION_SEVERITY
skip_conditions: status == under_review with an open EscalationRecord
evidence signature is under a live SuppressionRecord
